I’m customizing everything 🤷‍♀️💕 Here’s some tiny ways to make your MacBook feel a little more personal 💻✨ 💬 1. Set a Custom Lockscreen Message: Add a favorite quote, your name, or contact info right below the clock (System Settings > Lock Screen > Show message when locked). 🖥️ 2. Add Extra Desktops: Keep work, cozy gaming, and browsing separated so your screen never feels cluttered (Swipe up with three fingers on your trackpad > click the + in the top right). 🎛️ 3. Customize Your Menu Bar: Hide the icons you never click and pin the controls you actually use (System Settings > Control Center, or hold Command and drag icons around). 🕰️ 4. Customize Your Lockscreen Clock: Switch up the font weight or dial back the translucency to match your wallpaper (System Settings > Lock Screen > Clock Appearance). #macbook #macbooktips #mac #macsetup #tipsandtricks  How to customize your Mac, aesthetic MacBook, MacBook tips and tricks, MacBook customization
